title: Nexus diagram
description: A Nexus diagram document (.nexus.json): a Drupal content model with its annotations and, optionally, its canvas layout and display settings. Nexus opens it with 'Open a saved diagram'.

$schema.description: The URL of this schema, so an editor can validate the document.

nexus.description: The version of the document format.

title.description: The diagram's title. Defaults to 'Content model'.

colors.description: Fill colour overrides, keyed by entity type.

symbols.description: Symbol overrides, keyed by entity type.

customTypes.description: Entity types beyond the built-in ones (node, taxonomy_term, media, paragraph, block_content, user, external).

entities.description: The entity bundles of the model, each with its fields.

annotations.description: Event, API and Callback nodes and the edges between any 2 nodes of the diagram.

layout.description: Canvas positions keyed by node id. Leave it out, or empty, and Nexus lays the diagram out when it opens.

ui.description: The panel arrangement Nexus saves with a diagram. Leave it out, or null, to keep the arrangement the browser already has.

machineName.description: A Drupal machine name: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

symbol.description: The shape that draws an entity type.

entity.description: An entity bundle, such as a content type or a vocabulary. Its id in the diagram is '<entityType>.<bundle>'.

bundle.description: The bundle's machine name, or '*' for an entity that stands for every bundle of its type.

note.description: Free text shown as a note badge.

description.description: The bundle's description, as its Drupal config gives it.

field.description: A field on an entity bundle. Its id in the diagram is 'field:<entityType>.<bundle>:<name>'.

fieldType.description: The Drupal field type, such as 'string' or 'entity_reference'.

kind.description: 'single' or 'multi' for a configured field, by its cardinality; 'system' for a base field; 'calculated' for a computed one.

cardinality.description: How many values the field holds: 1, a limit above 1, or -1 for unlimited. Defaults to -1 for a 'multi' field and 1 for any other.

note.description: Free text shown as a note badge.

targetType.description: The entity type a reference field points to, or null for a field that references nothing.

targetBundles.description: The bundles a reference field points to. Empty points it to the '<targetType>.*' entity.

hidden.description: True keeps the field off the canvas.

description.description: The help text editors see under the field.

defaultValue.description: The value a new item starts with, as text.

allowedValues.description: The values a list field offers, in order.

translatable.description: Whether the field's value can differ per language. Leave it out when the source doesn't say.

label.description: The label editors pick. Defaults to the value.

annotationNode.description: An Event, API or Callback node. Its id is the id it's given here.

method.description: A second line of text, such as an HTTP verb.

note.description: Free text shown as a note badge.

annotationEdge.description: An edge between 2 nodes of the diagram, named by their ids.
